summary: Shinhan Financial Group disclosed via Form 6-K that boards of two wholly-owned subsidiaries, Shinhan Asset Trust (surviving) and Shinhan REITs Management (dissolving), approved a merger expected effective January 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval on August 14, 2026 and regulatory approvals. This is a routine intra-group reorganization, not a special situation for the registrant—no external deal, price, premium, or third-party consideration involved. No deal terms stated. Watch for regulatory clearance and any change in completion date; no risk-arb angle applicable as both entities are wholly owned.
